notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass
notes.content:
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url][/i] is finally available on Steam!
After months of work, the second episode of the Scary Shadow Spot series is ready to take you on a journey into psychological horror, filled with eerie puzzles and hidden truths.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Cursed Saloon and the Mystery of John Doe[/h2]
This time, you’ll be thrown into the heart of the Wild West, in a forgotten saloon lost in the desert. Here, time has stopped, and the ghosts of a dark past are waiting… for you.
Who is John Doe? What really happened at Bicchiere Amaro? Only by exploring the saloon and solving its puzzles will you uncover the truth.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Psychological Horror Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2]
Like the first episode, Bicchiere Amaro draws inspiration from the legendary series The Twilight Zone, delivering a story shrouded in mystery, with plot twists that will make you question everything you think you know.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]What to Expect[/h2]
✔️ A chilling and surreal atmosphere.
✔️ Puzzles that will test your logic.
✔️ A cast of… dead characters.
✔️ A story that will pull you in until the final revelation.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Add the Game to Your Wishlist![/h2]
If you enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096050/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Ultimo_Addio]Ultimo Addio[/url], you’ll love [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Bicchiere Amaro[/url] too. And if you haven’t played the first episode yet, now is the perfect time to catch up!

💀 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url] is available NOW on Steam!
📌 Add it to your library and let us know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell: The Release is Near!
notes.content:
[i]Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farwell[/i] is now in its final stages! After months of hard work, I am thrilled to announce that the game is [b]almost ready[/b] for the official release.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Feedback from Beta Testers[/h2] I had the privilege of having the game tested by a group of selected beta testers, and their feedback has helped refine every detail. The eerie atmosphere and twists that define the game have been polished to offer you an unforgettable experience.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2] The game is inspired by the legendary TV series [i]The Twilight Zone[/i]. Every puzzle, every shadow, has been designed to make you doubt what is real and what lurks in the depths of the mind.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Questions? We Are Here to Answer![/h2] Do you have any curiosities or questions about [i]Scary Shadow Spot[/i]? We are here to answer anything that comes to mind. What secrets are hidden in Mark's house? What awaits you in the darkness? We can't wait to hear your questions!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Thank You for the Support![/h2] Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release day.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]

[previewyoutube=MUQzjq8dcP0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: UPDATE 2.5.0 | BIG NEWS
notes.content:
Seventh Update for Lost Alone Ultimate!
Lost Alone Ultimate continues to grow, and a major update awaits you! In this version 2.5.0, you will find lots of new features:

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added voiceover in Italian, English, German, French, and Spanish.
[*] Reconstructed all the game's cutscenes.
[*] Added "camera depth effect" in every cinematic.
[*] Completely reconstructed in-game dialogues for a third-person narrative in line with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700240/Bloody_Ink/]Bloody Ink[/url].
[*] Added plot details clarifying the connection with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211640/Who_Knocks/]Who Knocks[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488890/The_Telephone/]The Telephone[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700240/Bloody_Ink/]Bloody Ink[/url].
[*] Added Automatic Saves in critical game areas.
[*] Corrected description errors of some items that had incorrect descriptions.
[*] Fixed the box collider that made it difficult to pick up the Toy Knife.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

[h2]If you have a game in progress, this update will CORRUPT ALL save files. In the Steam settings, you can select the version of Lost Alone Ultimate you are playing to continue with your game.[/h2]

notes.title: FREE DEMO OF BLOODY INK
notes.content:

notes.title: UPDATE 2.0.5 | COLLECTIBLE CARDS
notes.content:
Sixth update for Lost Alone Ultimate!
George has no intention of leaving you, and he has a big surprise for you: [b]THE STEAM COLLECTIBLE CARDS FOR LOST ALONE HAVE ARRIVED[/b]! Can you collect them all?
But that's not all! Here are all the changes and news.

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Lost Alone-themed Steam Collectible Cards have arrived.
[*] Improved graphics and game stability.
[*] Contextual icons have been added! Now you won't have doubts about which doors to open or which puzzles to solve.
[*] Fixed the issue preventing the opening of specific drawers.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

[h2]If you have a game in progress, this update will corrupt the save files. In the Steam settings, you can select the version of Lost Alone Ultimate you are playing to continue with your game.[/h2]

notes.title: UPDATE 2.0.1 | MEGA UPDATE AND DLC LAUNCH: "GEORGE'S NIGHTMARE"
notes.content:
The fifth update of Lost Alone Ultimate is now available and will leave you speechless. Alongside this update, a DLC that will test your fear resistance is also being released: "George's Nightmare."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43933190/58f8048712abcbb7a40e2a6ef3c12748d000fefe.png[/img]

But it's not just a DLC being added! Everything in Lost Alone Ultimate has been IMPROVED. Here's the list of the new features you'll find in the game!

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Voiceovers! The game has been completely voiced, and now you can hear the characters' voices!
[*] All cutscenes have been reviewed.
[*] Jump scares have been modified. With a new identification system, escaping moments of fear will be impossible.
[*] Crosshair Icons: UI icons have been added throughout the game to guide you during gameplay.
[*] Translation errors that confused "he" and "she" have been fixed.
[*] Minor bugs have been corrected.
[/list]

[h2]If you have a game in progress, this update will corrupt the save files. I recommend not updating the game unless you are playing for the first time.[/h2]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.2 | A DELIGHT FOR THE EYES
notes.content:
The fourth update of Lost Alone Ultimate is now available and will dazzle your eyes.
The lights, reflections, textures... Everything that can enchant your gaze has been enhanced.
In this update, the system managing lights, shadows, reflections, and textures has been completely overhauled to provide depth and realism to Lost Alone, allowing you to immerse yourself even more concretely in the fear that will surround you in this experience!

[h2]Note: If you have a game in progress, this update will corrupt your save files. I recommend not updating the game if you're not playing for the first time.[/h2]

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved and rebuilt the game's graphics from scratch.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.1 | SAVING ISSUES SOLVED
notes.content:
Here we are with the third update of Lost Alone Ultimate.
This update is very important as it fixes the saving issues that some of you have encountered.

[h2]If you have an ongoing game, this update will corrupt your save files.[/h2]
[h1]But don't worry![/h1]
In the main menu, you will find the option "Have you lost your saves?" which will allow you to restore all of your game saves.

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved game saving issues.
[*] Added the ability to recover multiple lost saves.
[*] Added new Easter Eggs.
[*] Improved some cutscenes.
[*] Resolved minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.0 | BYE BYE SHADOW...
notes.content:
Here we are with the second update of Lost Alone Ultimate. This update is very important because it introduces a new game mode: "the ability to disable the Shadow" and it improves all the game mechanics. By observing your gameplay and following your feedback, this update significantly enhances the entire game!

[h2]If you have a saved game in progress, this update will corrupt your save files.[/h2]
[h1]But don't worry![/h1]
To prevent you from losing all your progress, we have included several save points in the "[b]Load Game[/b]" feature. Simply load the game that is closest to your original save file.

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the possibility to play without the presence of the Shadow. At the beginning of each chapter, you can decide whether to face the Shadow or play without its pursuit.
[*] Decreased the Shadow's chasing speed.
[*] Added new Easter Eggs.
[*] Changed some game music.
[*] Made the Hospital key more visible.
[*] Made the Counter Room key more visible.
[*] Fixed the bug that allowed the player to take a Cassette Tape through the wall of the Parents' Room.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the Special Candle disappear.
[*] Resolved minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE COMING SOON
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I'm glad that you're enjoying Lost Alone Ultimate, and I've been following your feedback and watching your gameplay. I've collected a series of tips and suggestions from you.

In a few days, an update will be released that will introduce these new features:

UPDATES:
[list]
[*] - Added the option to play without the Shadow's presence. At the beginning of each chapter, you can decide whether to face the Shadow or play without being chased by it.
[*] - Reduced the Shadow's chasing speed.
[*] - Added new Easter Eggs.
[*] - Changed some game music.
[*] - Made the Hospital key more visible.
[*] - Made the Control Room key more visible.
[*] - Fixed the bug that allowed players to obtain a cassette tape through the wall in the Parents' Room.
[/list]

If you have any requests, ideas or suggestions, write them in the comments and I'll make sure to introduce them into the game!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0 | ACHIEVEMENTS ARE HERE
notes.content:
Here we are with the first update for Lost Alone Ultimate. This update is very important because it introduces [b]achievements[/b] in the game (37 of them!) and improves all game mechanics. Based on your gameplay and feedback, this update significantly enhances the overall game experience!

[h2]If you have a saved game in progress, this update will corrupt your save files.[/h2]
[h1]But don't worry![/h1]
To prevent you from losing all your progress, we have included several save points in the "[b]Load Game[/b]" feature. Simply load the game that is closest to your original save file.

We recommend starting the game from the beginning if you want to embark on the achievement hunt!

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 37 achievements
[*] Fixed the bug that caused objects to spawn in different positions on some computers.
[*] Added the option to skip Jumpscare animations.
[*] Significantly reduced camera shake when George is scared.
[*] Corrected some typos in the text.
[*] Fixed the graphics of the postcards for the Blue Flame.
[*] Reduced the sound of thunder and their frequency.
[*] Fixed the jukebox that allowed players to take the mannequin's hand too early.
[*] Reduced the fear caused by some entities.
[*] Added 4 new Easter Eggs.
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO: Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before
notes.content:
[h1][b]LOST ALONE ULTIMATE[/b] is coming![/h1]

Get ready to dive back in as [b]George Tellaselv[/b].
Whether you are entering this adventure for the first time or have already played the Lost Alone trilogy: you are about to discover a [b]new[/b] world of terror.

Lost Alone Ultimate is not a remake of the [b]Lost Alone[/b] trilogy, but a [b]re-made[/b]!

To let you savor the new world that awaits you, the demo is now available: [b]Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before[/b].

You will experience the day leading up to the events of Lost Alone Ultimate, savoring a light appetizer of the terror that awaits you.

[b]Lost Alone Ultmate - The Day Before[/b] is a self-contained demo that offers content that [b]won't be present in the final game[/b].

So: Enjoy a little secret sneak peek into George's life.
